description: This file is a Spring Security configuration class defining security policies, authentication setup, and URL access restrictions for a web application.

classes.name: WebSecurityConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for setting up web security using Spring Security, including role-based URL access restrictions, login, logout, and password encoding.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Bean configuration method that creates and provides a BCryptPasswordEncoder instance for securing passwords.

methods.name: configure (AuthenticationManagerBuilder)
methods.description: Configure authentication by setting the UserDetailsService and password encoder.

methods.name: configure (HttpSecurity)
methods.description: Configure HTTP security, including URL authorizations, login, logout, and CSRF settings.
